correctness.rationale: Up to three removed edges the deleted graph is a forest. In each displayed shape the bipartition fixes the placement up to shore permutations and an optional shore swap; orbit sizes in table order are 1,9,18,18,6,36,36,6, totaling 130. The admitted incidence matchings are rooted forests: along any undirected cycle, outdegree ≤1 and using each edge once force a directed cycle. Independently enumerated rooted forests and checked the frozen pivot orders by a fresh reconstruction and DFS of the directed face poset. Every orbit has one critical 0-cell, no critical 1- or 2-cells, and the stated critical 3- and 4-cell counts. As an independent route to the degree calculation, exact rational ranks of the original signed simplicial boundaries give Betti numbers in dimensions 3 and 4 equal to the critical counts (python /workspace/reproductions/morse.py). Thus the Morse cellular ∂4 is zero over Q and hence over Z. Each 4-cell attaches to a wedge of 3-spheres, where Hurewicz identifies π3 with integral H3. The zero degree vectors therefore imply nullhomotopic attaching maps; this is stronger than a field Betti check. This proves the full table and sharp first contractibility threshold, with no extension beyond the eight orbits.

evidence: For the perfect matching of faults, GM(C6) is the ordinary Morse complex with just the two 5-simplices of full cyclic orientations added. Theorem 20 gives GM(C6) ≃ S³∨S³. The long exact sequence gives two H4 generators represented by the attaching 4-spheres; H3 is unchanged and represented by spheres since attaching 5-cells preserves π_i for i≤3. The subcomplex is simply connected for the same reason. These sphere maps form a homology equivalence from the claimed wedge, hence a homotopy equivalence. Thus the exact C6 row is an implication even without Kozlov full text.

The deleted-three-edge-path graph leaves a C4 with leaves at two adjacent vertices. Lemma 29's domination applies at both anchors (each leaf's incidence used for domination remains after reduction at the other anchor). The reduced face complex is a join with two S⁰ factors; the remaining incidence graph, omitting isolated nodes, is a five-vertex path. Its matchings are acyclic and form Ind(P4), a contractible complex. Thus the contractible row itself follows from prior collapse, though the assertion that no smaller fault produces contractibility needs more.
claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: These prior implications limit the novelty to the complete profile and the resulting threshold. They do not give the remaining fault rows or the noncontractibility of all smaller faults. The value judgment is for the full deletion comparison, not for recomputing a cycle or a leaf criterion.

value.rationale: The complete small-biclique classification gives a natural sharp threshold for contractibility and distinguishes faults of equal cardinality by exact integral homotopy. The comparison, including cases with both 3- and 4-spheres, is not determined by generic connectivity or Euler characteristic, and is useful independently of the prior isolated rows. It makes no claim for larger bicliques or more faults.
